verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers knowledge gap detection and content suggestions (docs-10/18), integrations without custom code, and agent iteration via Duet, but nowhere mentions automatic re-syncing of knowledge sources on a schedule or on change — the closest analog (Suggestions) generates draft content for humans to review/publish, not an automated re-sync pipeline. Missing for 10: any mention of scheduled/triggered re-ingestion of source documents, sync frequency, or change-detection on connected knowledge bases.
